name: Jordan Avery
title: Software Engineer
summary: Software engineer with five years building and running backend services for high-traffic consumer products.

bullets.text: Built an order-routing service in Go that replaced a legacy PHP monolith, cutting p95 checkout latency by 42%.
Worked on the migration of 30 services onto K8s alongside the platform team.
Owned the on-call rotation for the payments domain and reduced pages per week from 14 to 3.
Helped improve observability by adding structured logging and Datadog dashboards across the fleet.
Designed a batch ingestion pipeline in Python that processed 8M events per day.
Responsible for schema design and query tuning on the primary Postgres cluster.
Wrote the internal client library other teams used to publish events.
Open-source CLI that reports replication lag across Postgres shards; used by three other teams internally.
